 procedure is to provide detailed safe method for transmission lines 
 maintenance staff to minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury 
 or damage to equipment for measuring earthing resistance - Circuit Energized - 
 by using Earth Tester.

EEC TL engineers in head office and 
 zones using their background field experience and EEC documentation to create 
 this procedure.

A work permit must be 
 issued.

Inspect the used cables 
 before use.

Wear safety shoes and 
 rubber gloves.

Dont touch any bare 
 conductor during measuring operation.

text:
Introduction
The purpose of this 
 procedure is to provide detailed safe method for transmission lines 
 maintenance staff to minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury 
 or damage to equipment for measuring earthing resistance - Circuit Energized - 
 by using Earth Tester.
EEC TL engineers in head office and 
 zones using their background field experience and EEC documentation to create 
 this procedure.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued.
Inspect the used cables 
 before use.
Wear safety shoes and 
 rubber gloves.
Dont touch any bare 
 conductor during measuring operation.
Tools and 
Equipment
Earth tester, Two probes.
Work to be Carried Out
Connect a jumper across the tower leg 
 and earth lead then connect the earth lead to the tower then disconnect the 
 jumper from the two sides.
